command:
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/workspace");old=root/"p24-node-proof-blocks-toy-20261126"/"attempt-004";out=root/"p24-toy-safety-inspect-20261126"/"attempt-001"
lean=Path("/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux/bin/lean")
assert hashlib.sha256(lean.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="e8baaa71855a616dc351028f3ad2200051b0671f423a1696a100e809302d5550"
def snap():return {str(p.relative_to(old)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(old.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
before=snap()
assert before["Toy.lean"]=="abe0febe06463b70f979d4ab911c837ef24c2dc02054bc553f98ce9758f89fae"
assert before["Toy.olean"]=="a6fef2f6c2e83085226ad9d1c4609b6c126e9ff5952cb847f2bd7e62dec8aa70"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=out/"Inspect.lean";source.write_text("import «p24-node-proof-blocks-toy-20261126».«attempt-004».Toy\nimport Lean\nopen Lean Elab Command in\nrun_cmd do\n  let env ← getEnv\n  let target := `«p24-node-proof-blocks-toy-20261126».«attempt-004».Toy\n  let some idx := env.getModuleIdx? target | throwError \"Missing target\"\n  let names := env.const2ModIdx.fold (init := (#[] : Array Name)) fun ns n i =>\n    if i == idx && (env.find? n).isSome then ns.push n else ns\n  let mut bad := 0\n  for name in names.qsort Name.lt do\n    let some info := env.find? name | throwError \"Missing owned declaration\"\n    if info.isUnsafe || info.isPartial || info.isAxiom then\n      bad := bad + 1\n      liftIO <| IO.println s!\"P24_UNSAFE_FLAG {(Json.mkObj [(\"name\", toJson name.toString), (\"unsafe\", toJson info.isUnsafe), (\"partial\", toJson info.isPartial), (\"axiom\", toJson info.isAxiom)]).compress}\"\n  liftIO <| IO.println s!\"P24_UNSAFE_SUMMARY {(Json.mkObj [(\"owned\", toJson names.size), (\"flagged\", toJson bad)]).compress}\"\n")
env=dict(os.environ);env["LEAN_PATH"]=str(root);env["LEAN_SYSROOT"]=str(lean.parent.parent)
command=[str(lean),"-t0","-j1","-M4096","-DwarningAsError=true","-DmaxRecDepth=50000","-DmaxHeartbeats=40000000",str(source)]
start=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(out/"inspect.log").write_bytes(r.stdout);print(r.stdout.decode(),end="",flush=True)
after=snap();assert before==after
receipt={"diagnostic_only":True,"all_credit":False,"exit_code":r.returncode,"seconds":time.monotonic()-start,"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"log_sha256":hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),"before":before,"after":after,"inputs_unchanged":True}
(out/"diagnostic.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+"\n");print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
